hero.title: Steppe
hero.subtitle: Venture into the land of eternal blue sky. From nomadic heritage to the spirit of the Khan, your Mongolian adventure begins here.

heritage.title: The Soul of the
heritage.description: Mongolian culture is a tapestry woven from nomadic freedom, hospitality, and a deep respect for the natural world.

stats.label: of the population still follow the nomadic way of life on the steppe.

cards.title: Radical Hospitality
cards.description: In the vast steppe, hospitality is enactional, not transactional. Every visitor to a rural ail (encampment) is welcomed as a public norm.

cards.title: The Ger Lifestyle
cards.description: About 30% of Mongolians still live in traditional gers (yurts). These portable dwellings offer resilience against extreme climates.

cards.title: Legacy of Empire
cards.description: Founded by Genghis Khan in the 1200s, the Mongol Empire's influence on Eurasian history remains a point of deep pride.

cards.title: Modern Harmony
cards.description: Ulaanbaatar blends modern urban life with ancient traditions, creating a unique democratic cultural identity.

mapExplorer.title: Steppe Landmarks
mapExplorer.description: From the frozen valleys to the modern sprawl.

landmarks.title: Yolyn Am (Valley of Vultures)
landmarks.description: A narrow canyon in the Gobi where ice sheets stay frozen deep into summer. Steep cliffs block sunlight, creating a hidden pocket of cold amidst the desert heat.

landmarks.title: Ulaanbaatar
landmarks.description: The world's coldest capital city. A fusion of Soviet-era architecture, modern glass towers, and sprawling ger districts that house over half the nation's population.

concierge.title: Your Custom Steppe Plan
concierge.description: Tell us what fascinates you about Mongolia—be it nomadic culture, eagle hunting, or extreme adventure—and our AI will craft a unique journey for you.
concierge.placeholder: e.g. I love nomadic food, horse riding, and visiting historical sites from the Mongol Empire...
concierge.travelNote: This itinerary is powered by advanced AI based on traditional Mongolian hospitality and ecological standards.

food.title: Taste of the Steppe
food.description: "Meat for the winter, dairy for the summer." Discover a culinary tradition built on nourishment and resilience.

items.name: Buuz
items.description: Steamed meat dumplings, juicy and filling, a staple of every celebration.

items.name: Khuushuur
items.description: Deep-fried meat pastries that provide essential energy for the nomadic life.

items.name: Tsuivan
items.description: A hearty noodle and meat dish, stir-fried to perfection with mountain herbs.

items.name: Airag
items.description: Fermented mare's milk, a national delicacy and a symbol of summer.

featured.title: Handmade Buuz
featured.description: Traditionally prepared with high-fat mutton to sustain during cold winters.

berkutchi.title: The Berkutchi Legend
berkutchi.description: In the snow-capped Altai, eagle hunting is not just a sport—it's a spiritual bond between man and bird, surviving for millennia.

cards.title: The Sacred Bond
cards.description: Eagles are considered revered family members, released back into the wild after years of loyal service.

cards.title: Winter Survival
cards.description: Hunting takes place in the harshest winter months, scanning the white horizon for prey with lethal precision.

survival.title: Survival & Logistics
survival.description: Expert advice for navigating the extreme Mongolian wilderness.

guides.title: Climate Control
guides.description: Prepare for extreme temperature swings. Freezing winters (dzud) and scorching summers require technical layering.

guides.title: Essential Gear
guides.description: Pack high-quality wool, sturdy riding boots, and sun protection. Solar power is vital for staying connected on the steppe.

guides.title: Cultural Etiquette
guides.description: Learn the rituals of the ger: enter with your right foot first, and never step on the threshold.

guides.title: Navigation
guides.description: Off-roading is the norm. Trust local drivers and download offline maps for the vast, roadless grasslands.
